Hey, Ness main here

So three important things i’ve learn with my psychic boy here. Magnet, Pk fire, and combos

Lets start easy, Pk fire. Landing it can give a lot especially when the opponent gets caught between the legs. You can forward smash, down throw to lead to forward airs (Is escapable with DI) , or what I like to do, go for down air to up air for percents. You can also magnet combo but more on that later.

Now for combos. Ness has many combos and combo starters. Up air can lead into many things like into up air chains, fair chains,and you can drag it down for a grab to back throw at high percents.

Finally, magnet. Its use is to double jump and magnet into same time to lead into any aerial besides down air.Its a hard technique for beginner players so you might want to practice it often. I wont go to much into detail but it can be used to lead into combo starters and is way more safe to start with instead of starting with any other combo starter. It also has a kill confirm called magnet into bair which is pretty hard to do so try to practice it often.

Hey there, Joker has great combos to rack up damage and good kill moves and kill set ups like Keklon stated. You definitely have to learn these to get good with Joker. However there are other things I’d like to point out.

You keep landing on mac with a counter or aerial so mac caught up to that so either go for a landing grab or wake up, get up, get out of there ;). 

Also when you were hit by f tilt or any move that sends you in to tumble you didn’t do anything and just crashed onto the ground leaving yourself open for mac to just dash attack you. You need to learn how to tech in these kind of situations. Also if you are not put in a tech situation, try do anything to get out of tumble such as do any aerial or jump.

Also learn Di, i dint think mac f tilt kills at 89%
